summary: Frontend-only validation completed on preview URL for craft-livelihood parity against attached reference image, responsive behavior, and live-editor integration. Core hero/header/intro/knowledge layout is largely matching at 1550 and 1440 with real image rendering confirmed (non-blank pixel samples).

integration_issues.issue: Repeated 401 resource errors in browser console during page loads (non-blocking visually, but noisy integration state remains).

issues: Image ratio renders at ~20:11 (1.818) instead of requested tablet 16:10 ratio.

action_items: Fix tablet breakpoint mapping so 1024-width presentation uses 16:10 hero image ratio per requirement.
Resolve repeated 401 media/resource requests during public page loads to remove console integration noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Craft reference-specific CSS scoping is correctly isolated to #craft-reference and :has(#craft-reference), minimizing regression risk to other pages.
Hero heading split and copy placement implementation is robust via line spans + fixed inset padding, and metrics match target at 1550/1440.
Live editor selection controls and resize handles are present and functional on craft hero (heading/intro/image selection + 8 handles observed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified by computed rects: nav block starts ~36.8%, hero width 91%, hero starts immediately after header (gap 0), heading lines exactly two, heading inset 64px and 56px from photo bottom at 1550/1440, intro left indent 21.2%, knowledge heading size 38px@1550 and 36px@1440, and two right-column paragraphs present. Image is fully rendered (naturalWidth > 0, decode complete, non-white pixel sample avg luminance ~146.9). Anonymous does not get editor on ?edit=1; owner login works and live-editor panel appears with selectable hero fields and resize handles. Full multi-page editor persistence re-check was partially blocked by nav selector reliability in this run; connect navigation with editor active was successful in the main test pass.
rca of the issue: RCA 1 (tablet ratio): CSS uses 16:10 only under max-width:960px, so 1024 falls back to desktop 20:11. Mitigation: expand tablet ratio breakpoint to include 1024. RCA 2 (401 noise): additional media requests are still being triggered by page content and return unauthorized; visual page remains functional, but unresolved media references/public access policy mismatch causes repeated console failures.
